what: Today: what needs me, and how am I doing. The money kept since the last look, one feed of decisions in three tiers, the notices, and one quiet line for what the agent did on its own.
frame: Who: everyone with something waiting; leans to the person clearing out their own things (primary persona), held up by the flipper's 40-card day and the new person's empty first launch.
How often: the most-seen screen, opened from launch, the tab and every push, several times a day; each card is answered in one tap, so every card has the same shape and the same four states.
What they came to do: see in a second whether it is working (the top slot) and whether anything needs them (the first card, nearest its deadline), then answer and leave.

Where a mistake costs most: an offer or a pickup that expires unseen, an address or a price sent without the person's tap, and an act that cannot be taken back. So deadlines lead, the safe choice is the black pill on a pickup, and every act holds 5 s with Undo before it reaches the site.

Ways out (spec/ways-out.md, Today): Later on every card (back before its deadline), More holds the rest of the actions and the way to the item or the chat, a batch can go One by one, the agent's amount can be changed in a sheet, and a held tap waits for signal. The person stays in the loop at every price, address and pickup: those wait for a tap, and what the agent did alone is one quiet line that opens its log with Undo.
decisions: The cards' words and order live in app/src/today/cards.ts, not in the screen, so they are tested in node and the item page can read the same card (one fact, one place).

The person and the state are read through useScreen() (app/src/demo/screen.ts), so Today draws every state at /?state=<s> like every page; ?world=stops and ?fail=<decision ids> are Today's own extras, because the demo has no server to fail.

On an offer card Accept leads (black when the card is the lead or due within the hour, C4) and the agent's counter is the second, though the data suggests the counter: the fact line shows what accepting keeps, and the person clearing out looks at what they keep, then accepts (pages §3).

On a pickup that asks for the home address, Keep the lot leads and Share address is the second: an address is shared only on the person's tap (decision 2026-11-14, locked), so the safe choice is the one the eye lands on.

Every act holds about 5 s behind an Undo toast before it reaches the site (Gmail's undo send), so even a sent reply or an accept can be taken back in that window; after it, the log and the site's own limits apply.
The batch of labels says what the tap spends (Labels cost $6.40), not what the sales keep, because the top slot already says that money (one fact, one place).

The handled line names the most frequent thing the agent did and how many others ('Took 2 listings down, and 1 more'), never a bare count, because Ben called '3 need you, 11 handled' meaningless (ledger L13); it opens its log in a sheet, with Undo where the site still allows it.
The notices and the handled line are the last rows of Good to know, since they ask nothing; the tier label shows only where two tiers meet.

A new person sees the next setup step in the top slot and one row, What's something worth?, instead of 'Nothing needs you': one display heading per view (A7), and 'needs you' means nothing before anything is listed.
Two pills and More hold about 26 characters of label; past that the second pill drops its amount, then moves to More (the edge world's $10,999.99 offer ran past the corner).
A queue opens full screen one item at a time (QueueView part); each Post leaves the stack, Not now keeps it as a draft, and the last one closes it and takes the card away.
The relink card has no item, so it shows the item stuck on that site with the site's badge: the photo still leads (C3).

A thing sold on two sites is one card, Sold twice, with Keep the first as the one tap and Compare opening both sales side by side (site, buyer's price, what each keeps, what cancelling each costs); the top slot counts it once until the person picks (spec/edge-cases.md §1).

Each stop on the auto-list tree is one card with one question in its fact line and the likely answer as the black pill, so a stopped tree costs a tap, never a restart; a retake opens the camera (spec/edge-cases.md §7). The stops world (/?world=stops) draws them all.
Every card's More ends with I did this already, Open the chat and Open the item (ways-out, Today: 'I already did that on the site', 'None of these buttons').
An amount typed under the person's lowest asks once in the sheet ('Under your lowest, $70. Tap again to send it.') instead of refusing: it is their call, made on purpose (edge-cases §3, Min persona).
One black pill per view (C4, DecisionCard): only the lead card, nearest its deadline, and any card due within the hour lead with black; every other card leads with the light fill.

The state one is one card drawn from the clearing day (the pickup), since the demo's one world has nothing to decide and on Today that is the empty state; failed asked for in the URL is the page that did not load, with Try again, and a card that failed is the failed state reached with ?fail=.
